# RAKSHAK-AI live end-to-end check (sandbox functional test)

> **What this is.** A functional test: real nginx, OpenSSH, Nmap and iptables running in an isolated sandbox, real log files, real HTTP and SSH traffic from test source addresses, and the real Rakshak console over its API. **What this is not.** It is not an accuracy measurement and says nothing about detection rates on production traffic. Items marked *simulated time* move a timestamp instead of waiting.

**Result: 65 of 72 checks passed.** Generated by `scripts/e2e_live_check.py`.
